title: Advent of Code 2026: My R Solutions
text:
Welcome to My Advent of Code 2026 Journey
NOTE: Seeing as it is 2026 and I am getting a bit older, I have made use of AI (Grok and Posit Assistant)to help me. Sometimes this has been used in a similar manner to Google (for reference) and sometimes for much more. I have left the private leaderboard because of this!
I always look forward to Advent of Code. As usual, I intend on using the power of the R programming language to solve each puzzle. This website showcases my (attempted) solutions, (hopefully decent) thought processes, and the creative ways (pleasepleaseplease) I leverage R’s data manipulation and visualization capabilities to crack the daily coding conundrums. Each day, I’ll share my code, explanations, and insights, offering a glimpse into how R can be used to solve complex problems.
The Advent of Code is an annual event that brings together programmers worldwide to solve bite-sized, festive coding challenges throughout December. My goal is to complete as many puzzles as I can while showcasing R’s versatility, from tidyverse workflows to custom algorithms.
Let’s celebrate the joy of coding this holiday season!
